title: Validation, filters, and Problem Details — concept map
intro: Input validation runs after model binding — data annotations on [ApiController] DTOs or FluentValidation in testable validator classes. Minimal APIs need IEndpointFilter to get the same 400 ValidationProblemDetails behavior. Cross-cutting controller logic uses IAsyncActionFilter. All errors should converge on RFC 7807 Problem Details with correlationId extensions, and unhandled exceptions map through IExceptionHandler (.NET 8+) behind outermost UseExceptionHandler middleware.

overviewDiagram.title: Validation and error response flow
overviewDiagram.source:
flowchart TD
  Req[HTTP Request] --> Bind[Model Binding]
  Bind --> Val{Validation}
  Val -->|annotations ApiController| Auto400[Auto 400 ValidationProblemDetails]
  Val -->|FluentValidation filter| FV400[400 from IEndpointFilter or auto filter]
  Val -->|valid| Handler[Controller Action or Minimal Handler]
  Handler -->|handled error| PD[Results.Problem / ProblemDetails]
  Handler -->|throw| EH[UseExceptionHandler]
  EH --> IXH[IExceptionHandler]
  IXH --> PDOut[application/problem+json + correlationId]
  Auto400 --> PDOut
  FV400 --> PDOut
  PD --> PDOut

conceptCards.title: Data annotations
conceptCards.summary: [Required], [Range], EmailAddress on DTO properties. [ApiController] auto-returns 400 ValidationProblemDetails. IValidatableObject for cross-field rules. Minimal APIs need explicit Validator.TryValidateObject.
conceptCards.example: ModelState.IsValid false → errors.Email array in JSON

conceptCards.title: FluentValidation
conceptCards.summary: AbstractValidator<T> with RuleFor, MustAsync, When. AddValidatorsFromAssembly + auto-validation for controllers. TestValidate unit tests. IEndpointFilter shares validators with minimal APIs.

conceptCards.title: Action filters
conceptCards.summary: IAsyncActionFilter wraps controller actions after binding. context.Result short-circuits before action. TypeFilter for DI. Not applied to minimal APIs.
conceptCards.example: IdempotencyFilter caches POST response by header key

conceptCards.title: Endpoint filters
conceptCards.summary: IEndpointFilter for minimal APIs and MapGroup. InvokeAsync with Arguments bound parameters. Return Results.ValidationProblem before await next().

conceptCards.title: Problem Details
conceptCards.summary: RFC 7807 application/problem+json. type, title, status, detail, instance, extensions. ValidationProblemDetails adds errors map. Prefer extensions over custom error envelopes.

conceptCards.title: Global exception handling
conceptCards.summary: Outermost UseExceptionHandler. IExceptionHandler TryHandleAsync + IProblemDetailsService. correlationId from X-Correlation-ID or TraceIdentifier. Developer page dev-only.
